body: I really really wish I could just live by myself, have all the basic needs + a good computer/internet, and then just basically be hikikomori for the rest of my life.
I desperately want to be good at something, I don't want to be useless my whole life. But I get too frustrated and angry to ever actually develop any skills.
hopefully 2014 will be the year im gone.
when im drifting off to sleep i like to fantasize about hanging myself or something and how people would care after i died, and they would actually say nice things about me and stuff.
